questions: Did your walking difficulty begin suddenly?
Has it been getting progressively worse?
Have you had any falls or near-falls?
Do you feel unsteady even when standing still?
Do you feel as if the room is spinning or as if you might faint?
Do you have weakness in either leg?
Do you have numbness or tingling in your legs or feet?
Is one side of your body more affected than the other?
Do you have back pain that travels into either leg?
Have you noticed a tremor in your hands or legs?
Do your movements feel stiff or unusually slow?
Do you take short, shuffling steps or have trouble starting to walk?
Do you veer to one side or walk with your feet unusually far apart?
Do you have difficulty with speech, swallowing, or coordination of your hands?
Have you had any recent head injury, infection, or new medication?
Have you lost control of your bladder or bowels?
Have you had a similar walking problem in the past?
